verdict: Yes, for a strong engineering team. Sunfox Technologies from Dehradun pitched a portable ECG device, Spandan, on Shark Tank India Season 1 and got a deal from all five sharks. Heart disease is a leading cause of death in India, and cheap portable ECGs help clinics and pharmacies screen people who can't reach a cardiologist.
angle: Portable ECGs sell to GPs, pharmacies, rural clinics and health-conscious families. Accuracy must match hospital machines, and CDSCO approval is required. Recurring revenue from reports or cardiologist review adds value.
